decisions.reason: The revised launch deadline and live-publication target do not change the digital PDF deliverable or its two-page-spread behavior.
The deadline change does not alter the required article-ending balance or the established whitespace remedies.
Requiring the flipbook to be live by a specified time does not change the free-hosting constraint or select among the candidate platforms.
The launch deadline does not modify the requirement to enhance low-quality publication images.
The revised launch timing does not add, remove, or otherwise change any required issue content.
The deadline and live-publication target do not change the author-name or author-photo requirements.
The launch deadline does not alter the requirement that advertisements render clearly.
The revised launch timing does not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number accuracy requirement.
The deadline change does not alter how long article text should be broken up with images, blurbs, or quotes.
The source decision changes launch timing, not the issue's ordering basis, article placement, or tribute-page placement.
The launch deadline and required live state do not modify the magazine's visual style or branding rules.
The revised launch deadline does not change the selected body typeface, weight treatment, or readability requirement.
